comment: Vendor rows the wiki still describes but the game no longer offers. The SMW scrape cannot tell a live vendor from one whose sale was removed in a patch when the page itself is not marked historical, and it does not read the historical marker on the pages that do carry one, so each entry here is a hand-verified refusal with its evidence. An entry with an outputItemId refuses that one (merchant, item) row; an entry with merchantName alone refuses every row of a merchant that no longer exists in the game. Applied by tools/VendorOfferUpdater at write time, so a refresh cannot reintroduce the row. Keep this list small: an entry is a claim that the shipped data is wrong, and it needs a source.

exclusions.reason: The Battle Master's 500 Badges of Honor sale was removed in the Spring 2016 Quarterly Update; Gift of Battle has since come only from the WvW Gift of Battle Item Reward Track. Shipping this row would price a legendary component from a vendor path that has not existed for a decade, and it contradicts this repo's own hand-verified acquisition hint for item 19678 (ref/acquisition_hints_seed.json, lastVerified 2026-07-20).

The NPC itself is gone, so the refusal is vendor-wide rather than per item: the wiki page carries 'status = Historical' (SMW 'Is historical = t', Category:Historical NPCs) and states the Battle Historian was replaced by the Skirmish Supervisor in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Its live successor is already in this dataset under 'Skirmish Supervisor' with 418 rows. All 49 scraped rows were priced in WvW Tournament Claim Tickets (item 66352), whose own page carries 'status = discontinued': the tournaments that awarded it last ran in 2014, the reward chests are discontinued, and consuming a held ticket now converts it to a WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket. That ticket has no coin valuation here, so every one of those rows ranked as free and undercut the real route for Dragonite Ore, Empyreal Fragment and Obsidian Shard.
